about_the_game:
A collection of 191 solitaire variants + 21 puzzles with NSFW pictures.

Press Space key in emergency to instantly switch to innocent standard cards on a green table. 

Win solitaire games and puzzles to unlock hundreds of pictures in the gallery.

Create card sets in the in-built editor with images, animated GIFs, or videos.

Note: if you don't need the porn, get Free Solitaire app of mine instead.

To hide the game from Steam friends: open Steam Library, right click on NSFW Solitaire in the list, Properties. This opens up a dialog. On the left, click "Privacy" tab. Toggle "Mark as Private".

To hide the game in Discord app: open Settings (cog button). On the left, in "Activity settings", open "Registered Games" tag, and for NSFW Solitaire click on "eye" to turn off detection.

content_descriptors.notes: Realistically drawn images of nude body, genitalia, and sex. DLCs also have insinuated consumption of alcohol, BDSM topics like bondage, spanking and rough sex. Some mature humor about sex and relationships.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable.
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
